desc:
⚽ PIXEL BLUE LOCK ⚽

🔥 Fast 5v5 pixel soccer! Pick any open spot and jump straight in a full 5v5.

📖 Play STORY MODE to put yourself into the Blue Lock story and become the #1 Striker!

🦶 Break ankles, flick it over defenders, smash first-time volleys and beat the Blue Lock Man in goal.

🎨 Unlock hats, kits, ball skins, trails and goal effects!

📱 Plays on PC, mobile and console!

 CONTROLS
 M1 - Shoot | M2 / R - Pass
 E - Tackle | Q - Dribble
 Space - Flick | Shift - Sprint
 1, 2 - Skills | G - Awaken | T - Flow
 Tab - Match Stats

⚠️ Unofficial fan-made game. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Kodansha or the creators of Blue Lock.
